7607 / 7608: Cortech Endurance Floor Mounted Desk
Product URL: https://www.anchortex.com/products/cortech-7607-endurance-floor-mounted-desk
Manufacturer page: https://cortechusa.com/products/furniture/endurance/endurance-freestanding-desk/
Spec sheets: 7607 / 7608, Installation
Recommended H1 and Subtitle
H1: Cortech Endurance Floor Mounted Desk – 7607 / 7608
Current H1: Cortech Endurance - Floor Mounted Desk - One-Piece Rotationally Molded - Models 7607 / 7608
Subtitle: One-Piece Molded Freestanding or Floor-Mounted Desk with Optional Laminate Top
Current subtitle: Cortech USA Endurance 7607 All Plastic Floor Mount Desk / 7608 Laminate Top Desk
Revised Product Description
Headings marked [H2] should be set as H2 on the page.
The Cortech Endurance Floor Mounted Desk is a one-piece molded desk that can stand on its own or be bolted to the floor. It is made for cells, patient rooms, and other rooms in intense use environments.
The desk is rotationally molded from high impact “no break” polyethylene, with no steel or wood components. It comes all plastic (7607) or with a smooth laminate top (7608) in a choice of standard Formica and Wilsonart finishes for a more normative look.
Material: One-piece rotationally molded high impact “no break” polyethylene; no steel or wood components
Dimensions: 36”W×24”D×29”H
Weight: 47 lbs
Top: All plastic (7607) or optional smooth laminate top (7608)
Laminate Top: Smooth laminate top in a choice of standard Formica and Wilsonart finishes
Mounting: Freestanding, or bolts to the floor through concealed pilot holes
Antimicrobial Testing: Tested to ISO 22196, showing a greater than 99% reduction in bacteria
Flammability Standards: Flame retardant; passes California Technical Bulletin 133 and UL 94 HB
Easy Cleaning: Sound dampening, and easy to clean, sanitize, and maintain
Base Colors: Aqua, Black, Blue Gray, Brown, Burgundy, Canvas, Claylight, Gray, Green, Indigo, Midnight Blue, Moss, Overcast, Sand, Seagrass, Slate Blue, Stone Gray, or Tide (custom colors available on request)
Warranty: Lifetime warranty on the all-plastic model; 5-year warranty on the laminate top
Country of Manufacture: USA, made to ISO quality standards
Available Models and Options
7607 – All Plastic: 36”W×24”D×29”H, 47 lbs
7608 – Laminate Top: 36”W×24”D×29”H, smooth laminate top
Installation and Options
Mounting: Use freestanding, or bolt to the floor through concealed pilot holes with hardware of your choice; see Cortech instructions
[H2] Applications
The Floor Mounted Desk suits rooms that need a durable desk, either freestanding or fixed to the floor.
Typical applications include:
Cells and housing units in correctional facilities and jails
Patient rooms in behavioral healthcare facilities and psychiatric hospitals
Residential treatment centers, classrooms, and study areas
Explore Anchortex's Behavioral Healthcare Anti-Ligature Furniture and Prison and Detention Furniture collections for more institutional furniture.
[H2] About Cortech Endurance Series
The Cortech Endurance Series is a line of heavy-duty molded furniture for behavioral healthcare facilities, correctional institutions, and other intense use environments. Endurance products are made for durability, easy cleaning, and safety-conscious design.
The Endurance Series includes:
Beds and Bunks: Endurance beds, wall-mounted bunks, and EZ Bunk stackable temporary sleep surfaces
Seating: Benches, cubes, and the Endurance ‘In Sync’ Modular Series chairs
Tables and Desks: Molded and laminate-top tables, freestanding desks, and wall-mounted desks, including ADA models
Storage: Lockers, nightstands, open chests, and shelving
[H2] About Cortech
Cortech manufactures durable molded furniture for demanding environments, including behavioral healthcare facilities, psychiatric hospitals, correctional institutions, law enforcement facilities, and homeless and emergency shelters. Explore the full line of Cortech Behavioral Health and Prison Furniture at Anchortex.
Meta Title and Description
Meta title (63 characters): Cortech Endurance Floor Mounted Desk - 7607 / 7608 at Anchortex
Meta description (147 characters): Shop the Cortech Endurance Floor Mounted Desk. A one-piece molded desk that stands alone or bolts to the floor, all plastic or with a laminate top.
Notes and Questions
Series section: this is the same "About Cortech Endurance Series" section as on the EZ Bunk page.
H1: I took out the extra dashes, "One-Piece Rotationally Molded," and "Models." Cortech calls it the "Freestanding Desk" or "Floor Mount Desk"; I kept your "Floor Mounted Desk."
Weight: both variants are set to 50 lbs. The Cortech spec sheet says 47 lbs and gives one weight for both tops, so I used 47 lbs for the 7607. Should the 7608 also be 47 lbs?
Warranty: your current page says 10-year warranty. The Cortech spec sheet says lifetime on the all-plastic desk and 5 years on the laminate top, so I used that.
Colors: your current page lists 6 colors. The Cortech spec sheet lists 18, so I used the Cortech list.
I left out "Stain resistant" and "can be wiped, mopped, or even hosed down," since the Cortech spec sheet does not say these.
Product images: the page has three images. The last image is the older Cortech color chart. Cortech now lists 18 colors. Would you like it replaced?
